Use Schedule 9 to supply both federal donations credit and the eligible gift claim for Nova Scotia. Manual donation-credit fields are ignored while enabled.
Use Schedule 7 to add RRSP deductions and HBP/LLP shortfall income to shared income automatically. Remove those amounts from generic income/deduction records first.

Receipt, certificate or pool reference; spouse ownership/allocation evidence.

Ordinary categories follow lines 1–4; cultural and ecological gifts follow line 11.
Eligible unclaimed amount available before this return. Exclude gifts already used on the 2024 return, including the Jan–Feb 2025 extension.
Amount elected for this return. Use older eligible gifts first within their applicable class; do not claim the same gift for both spouses.
Last year to claim this pool (five years; ten for ecological gifts in the supported carryforward window).
Counts claims above the pool or outside its permitted origin-year window.
Claim elected within the ordinary category.

Unclaimed eligible amount with at least one future year remaining.
Unclaimed amount expiring this year or already expired.
One chart per depreciable-property class. Aggregate min(net proceeds, capital cost) across gifts in that class before entering the class result.

Gift-related recapture included in this return, limited to the gift portion after advantages.
Sum, for this class, of min(net proceeds, capital cost) for each donated property.
Schedule 9 line 33700 class amount.
Current-year taxable capital gains attributable to donated property, after gift-portion adjustments. Already included once in the capital-income facts.
Capital gains deduction attributable to those donated-property gains. Already claimed in Division C where applicable.

Total line 33700 from class charts.

Eligible claim exceeding the first $200.
Lesser of donations above $200 excluding old ecological gifts and taxable income over the top-bracket threshold.
Remaining claim above $200.
First $200 at the annual lowest federal rate, plus 33% and 29% portions. This final credit is outside the ordinary nonrefundable-credit percentage.
8.79% of first $200 plus 21% of the balance of the same elected eligible gifts.

Eligible Schedule 7 line 15 transfers included in own contributions and taxable source income. Exclude direct tax-deferred transfers not reportable on Schedule 7. Does not consume ordinary deduction room.
Ordinary contributions elected to deduct this year, excluding transfers. May be less than the maximum to carry contributions forward.

Part E: designate spouse/common-law partner as LLP student in the first withdrawal year.
